transfer_contract.method: Optimize a new latent through the frozen released source core and alignment; copy only that latent into target's identical frozen core and released target alignment.
transfer_contract.limitation: Novel task learning in a fixed released 256-dimensional latent space is an experimental extension; released benchmark transfer claims do not establish its effectiveness.
